<b>Injector Band</b> is a {{CrestSlot|Blue|1}} in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. It speeds up the act of Binding.

== Usefulness ==
Speeds up [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]]'s [[Bind]] by 40%, reducing the chance of it being interrupted in combat and providing more windows to do so safely.
* Increases the speed of the [[Beast Crest]] and [[Witch Crest]]'s Binds, but does not increase the speed of the [[Architect Crest]]'s Craft Bind.
* It can be used to mitigate the longer Binding time from [[Multibinder]], resulting in increased healing with a slightly faster than normal Binding time.

== How to Acquire ==
Found in the lower eastern section of [[Whiteward]], above the passage with the [[Mortician]]s.
